name: The Tome of Divinity

meta.previous: Tome of Divinity (Azar Stronghammer) / Tome of Divinity (Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker) / Tome of Divinity (Brandur Ironhammer)

summary: In Ironforge, Tiza Battleforge places the Tome of Divinity in a dwarven paladin's hands. Its teachings begin trials meant to test devotion to the Light and readiness to defend Azeroth from dark forces such as the Scourge.

sections.title: A Calling to Virtue
sections.body: Promising paladin initiates from across the eastern kingdoms come to Ironforge's Hall of Mysteries after mastering the martial and spiritual basics. Tiza Battleforge guides young dwarven paladins in the principles that set a champion of the Holy Light apart from an ordinary warrior. Taking up this calling means pledging a life to duty, self-sacrifice, and spiritual discipline.

sections.title: The Book of Divinity
sections.body: The novice receives the Book of Divinity as a guide to its duties, virtues, and spiritual teachings. Its words show how sacred power may be wielded against wicked threats. Study is only the first step; the initiate must carry those lessons into acts of faith across Khaz Modan and beyond.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Tome of Divinity quest?
aliases: what does tome of divinity do
faq.answer: The Tome of Divinity begins advanced training for dwarven paladins. Tiza Battleforge gives initiates a holy book and sends them on trials to prove their virtue and learn to call fallen allies back from death.

aliases: who is the paladin trainer in ironforge
faq.answer: Tiza Battleforge is a paladin trainer in Ironforge's Hall of Mysteries. She guides dwarven paladins toward greater virtue, tests their devotion to the Light, and prepares them to face threats such as the Scourge.

faq.q: Why must initiates study the Book of Divinity?
aliases: what is the book of divinity
faq.answer: The Book of Divinity teaches the duties and virtues demanded by the Holy Light. Its teachings prepare initiates for the spiritual discipline needed to wield sacred powers.

faq.q: What major threats are dwarven paladins preparing to fight?
faq.answer: Dwarven paladins prepare to defend Azeroth from dangers across the land, especially the encroaching undead menace of the Scourge.

faq.q: Where does this training take place?
faq.answer: The training begins in the Hall of Mysteries, in Ironforge's northern quarters, where scholars, priests, mages, and paladins gather for prayer and study.

faq.q: What comes next after receiving the book?
aliases: where do i go after getting the book
faq.answer: After reading and reflecting on the Book of Divinity, the initiate faces practical trials from Tiza Battleforge. These call for compassion, duty, and sacrifice beyond the city gates.

angles.text: As a paladin, this rite carries you from martial training into the deeper virtues of the Holy Light, toward powers of redemption and resurrection.
As a dwarf, taking up the Tome of Divinity strengthens the bond of faith between the Bronzebeard kingdom and the human knights of the Silver Hand.
